issues.title: Please add a Story feature, similar to Dantotsu
issues.body:
### Feature Summary

**Dear @RyanYuuki and @itsmechinmoy,**

In Dantotsu, the Story and Friend Watching and Rating List features only work for users who use AniList. Although watched anime can be added automatically (similar to Anymex), these features only display AniList friends.

I would like to request that you implement a similar feature, but designed in the Anymex way. The Story feature help users see what their friends are currently watching. 

#### Please find the attached screenshot below, where the Story feature is highlighted:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/93601621-94c3-4938-a0d3-34213771cffe)

I sincerely hope you consider implementing these features in the future, as they would greatly improve the overall user experience.

Thank you.

### Detailed Description

### Current Behavior
- In Dantotsu, the Story feature is only available for users who use AniList.
- Even though watched anime can be added automatically, social features remain limited to AniList connections.
- Users who do not rely on AniList cannot fully benefit from these features.

### Proposed Solution
- Implement a Story feature within Anymex that is independent of AniList limitations.
- Allow users to see what their friends are currently watching.
- Improve social interaction and overall user experience within the app.

### Considerations
- Cross-platform compatibility may be required (AniList / MyAnimeList / native Anymex accounts).
- Privacy controls should be considered for activity visibility.
- Synchronization of watch status and ratings may introduce technical complexity.
- An alternative approach could be optional linking of external accounts while maintaining native functionality.


### Additional Context

I will attach a screen recording from my Dantotsu app where the Story and Friend Watching and Rating List features are highlighted. Please review the video and consider implementing similar features in both the PC and smartphone versions of the app.

You may integrate AniList and MyAnimeList, or alternatively, develop a native cross-platform system where users can log in or create an account to access advanced features. 

#### This could allow users to:
- View what their friends are currently watching or reading
- See ratings for anime, manga, and novels
- Sync watch/read progress and timestamps between phone and PC simultaneously
- Use Story and Friend activity features across devices
- Follow or connect with friends and track their activity

Below, I have attached the screen recording for reference:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a3b5d761-41f7-49a2-b5c8-185b40d2d3b3

I hope that by reviewing the information I have provided, as well as the screenshots and screen recording video, you will find them helpful and consider implementing these features as soon as possible.

issues.title: Anymex desktop app sometimes freezes when switching to full-screen mode or pressing F11, both in the player and the app.
issues.body: ### Steps to Reproduce **Dear @RyanYuuki and @itsmechinmoy,** I want to report a bug I am experiencing on my laptop with Anymex version 3.0.4. The issue occurs when entering full-screen mode, either by clicking the full-screen button in the player (highlighted in the image below): or by pressing the F11 key in the desktop app. Below, I will provide my laptop specifications and OS version: #### Laptop Version: - **Device Name:** RAJIN★STAR - **Device Model:** MSI Modern 15 A5M - **Processor:** AMD Ryzen 5 5500U with Radeon Graphics (2.10 GHz) - **Installed RAM:** 8.00 GB (7.36 GB usable) - **System type:** 64-bit operating system, x64-based processor - **Pen and touch:** Pen support #### OS Version: - **Edition:** Windows 11 Pro - **Version:** 25H2 - **Installed On:** Sat, ‎Oct ‎12, ‎2024 I hope the above information will help in resolving the issue. Thank you. ### Expected Outcome - The app should smoothly enter full-screen mode without freezing or getting stuck. - Users should be able to toggle full-screen on and off via both the player button and F11 key without any performance issues. - Full-screen mode should maintain proper video playback and app responsiveness. ### Actual Outcome - The app sometimes freezes or becomes unresponsive when entering full-screen mode. - Clicking the full-screen button in the player or pressing F11 may cause the video playback to stop. - Users are unable to interact with the app until it is restarted. - The issue occurs intermittently but affects both the player button and F11 methods. - Full-screen mode does not function as expected, disrupting the viewing experience. ### Error Logs (if applicable) I will also attach the Error Logs file below to help the developers resolve the issue: [Anymex Error Logs.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25333350/Anymex.Error.Logs.txt) Please download it, review it carefully, and resolve this issue as soon as possible. Then, release the latest version with the issue fixed. ### AnymeX Version 3.0.4 ### Operating System Version Windows 11 Pro 25H2 ### Device Information MSI Modern 15 A5M ### Additional Information I will provide a video to help the developers understand the problem. Unfortunately, I could not perform a screen recording on my laptop due to some issues, so I recorded the video using my phone camera. Hopefully, the video will help you understand the issue. In the video, I demonstrate that when I click the full-screen icon in the player, the screen becomes stuck or frozen. The audio continues to play, but the video stops. This problem also occurs in the main app when I press the F11 key to enter full-screen mode. Below, I have attached the video: https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/989ee86c-ed25-4e2d-a5ff-13112bbb1061 By watching the video above, I hope you can identify and resolve the problem in the next update. I also kindly request that you consider implementing the three features I suggested before this bug report. Fixing this bug and adding those features will greatly enhance the user experience and make the app much more enjoyable to use. ### Submission Checklist - [x] I have searched existing issues to confirm this is not a duplicate. - [x] I am using the **[latest](https://github.com/RyanYuuki/AnymeX/releases/latest)** version of AnymeX. issues.title: Please add an offline download mode for anime, manga, and novels on both desktop and smartphone platforms
issues.body:
### Feature Summary

**Dear @RyanYuuki and @itsmechinmoy,**

This is my last feature request for now, but this feature is very crucial for us. I know I’ve been requesting a lot, but these features help us watch anime, read manga, and novels offline. A friend of mine previously wanted to download an anime from Anymex but failed because there was no offline download option. In the end, he had to go to the official YouTube anime channel, Muse Asia, to manually download all the episodes, as he had WiFi issues at the time. Therefore, I am requesting that this feature be included in the next version of the app.

Thank you.

### Detailed Description

### Current Behavior
- Currently, the app does not support offline downloads for anime, manga, or novels.
- Users who want to access content without an active internet connection cannot do so.

### Proposed Solution
- Implement an offline download mode for anime, manga, and novels on both desktop and smartphone platforms.
- Users should be able to download episodes, chapters, or volumes directly to their device for offline access.
- This feature will improve accessibility, allow uninterrupted content consumption, and enhance user satisfaction, particularly for those with unstable or limited internet connections.

### Considerations
- Storage management will be important; the app should allow users to choose download quality and location, and manage downloaded content.
- An option to automatically delete watched/read content or manage downloads efficiently could further improve the user experience.


### Additional Context

I will also include a screen recording from my Android phone’s Anymex app. Although this video was recorded on the Android version, the same issue exists on the desktop version for Windows 11. The screen recording is attached below:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/6c148c0b-b5bd-48b1-8efb-bce99aa2accc

In the screen recording, I will show exactly where the offline download feature should be added in the Anymex app. Please consider my request and address all of my concerns as soon as possible in the next update.

issues.title: sorting options for anime/manga list.
issues.body:
### Feature Summary

Sorting for the list only allows you to sort by last updated, either from greatest to smallest or vice versa. However, we currently lack features to sort alphabetically, by chapters/episodes remaining, unread count, latest chapter update, user score, or even randomly.

### Detailed Description

### Current Behavior
Sorting for the list only allows sorting by last updated, either from greatest to smallest or vice versa. No other sorting options are currently available.

### Proposed Solution
Introduce additional sorting features to enhance user experience. These should include:

    Alphabetical sorting.
    Sorting by chapters/episodes remaining.
    Sorting by unread count.
    Sorting by the latest chapter update.
    Sorting by user score.
    A random sorting option.

a dropdown menu when you click sort might be nice
